:root{--bg:#E8E4E0;--fg:#1A1818;--fg-rgb:26,24,24;--accent:#6B4F4F;--room:#FBFAF8;

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scrollbar-width:none}html::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
body{min-height:100vh;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--font);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}

.wrap{max-width:88rem;margin:0 auto;padding:24px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 0 max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}

/* ---------- brand worlds: each campaign hangs on its own line, in its own colours ---------- */
.worlds{position:relative}
.world{position:relative;height:var(--h,300vh)}
.pin{position:sticky;top:var(--nav-h,64px);height:calc(100svh - var(--nav-h,64px));overflow:hidden;background:var(--wbg);color:var(--wfg);

.w-kicker{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wacc)}
.w-kicker i{display:block;width:28px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
.w-name{font-family:var(--font);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,6.4vw,92px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap}

  const nav = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--nav-h')) || 64;
  const vh = innerHeight - nav;
  worlds.forEach(w => {
    const head = w.el.querySelector('.w-head').offsetHeight;
    const ph = Math.max(150, Math.min(vh - head - (innerWidth < 768 ? 110 : 150), innerWidth < 768 ? 420 : 560));
    w.el.style.setProperty('--ph', ph + 'px');
    w.prints.forEach(p => { const img = p.el.querySelector('img'); img.style.width = (ph - 30) * (+p.el.style.getPropertyValue('--ar')) + 'px'; });
    // stop exactly when the last print is fully in view (the wire itself runs off both edges, so it doesn't count)
    const last = w.prints[w.prints.length - 1].el, pad = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(w.track).paddingLeft) || 0;
    w.dist = Math.max(0, last.offsetLeft + last.offsetWidth + pad - innerWidth);
    w.el.style.setProperty('--h', (vh + w.dist * (innerWidth < 768 ? 1.1 : 1)) + 'px');
  });
}
layout(); addEventListener('resize', layout); document.fonts?.ready.then(layout);

// scrolling down walks you along the line; the prints swing as they pass, as if the line moved
let lastT = 0, active = -1;
function frame(t){
  const dt = Math.min(48, t - (lastT || t)) / 16.67; lastT = t;
  const nav = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--nav-h')) || 64;
  worlds.forEach((w, i) => {
    const r = w.el.getBoundingClientRect(), span = Math.max(1, r.height - (innerHeight - nav));
    const p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (nav - r.top) / span));
    w.x = -p * w.dist;
    const vel = (w.x - w.lx) / Math.max(dt, .5); w.lx = w.x;
    w.track.style.transform = `translate3d(${w.x.toFixed(1)}px,0,0)`;
    w.bar.style.setProperty('--p', p.toFixed(4));
    const on = r.top < innerHeight && r.bottom > nav;
    if (!on || reduced) return;
    w.prints.forEach(pr => {
      const idle = Math.sin(t / 1000 * pr.sp + pr.ph) * 1.1;
      const target = Math.max(-11, Math.min(11, vel * .55)) + idle;
      pr.v += (target - pr.a) * .045 * dt; pr.v *= Math.pow(.88, dt); pr.a += pr.v * dt;
      pr.el.style.transform = `rotate(${pr.a.toFixed(2)}deg)`;
    });
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

// ---------- lightbox ----------
const lb = document.getElementById('lb'), lbI = document.getElementById('lbI'), lbT = document.getElementById('lbT'), lbD = document.getElementById('lbD');
let L = { items: [], i: 0, title: '' }, lastFocus = null;
function show(i){
  L.i = (i + L.items.length) % L.items.length;
  lbI.classList.add('swap');
  const it = L.items[L.i], pre = new Image(); pre.src = it.f;
  const stage = lbI.parentElement;
  const go = () => { lbI.src = it.f; lbI.classList.remove('swap'); stage.classList.remove('ld'); };
  if (pre.complete) go(); else { if (it.w && it.h) stage.style.setProperty('--ar', (it.w / it.h).toFixed(4)); stage.classList.add('ld'); pre.onload = go; pre.onerror = go; }
  lbI.alt = `${L.title}, ${L.i + 1} of ${L.items.length}`;   // so a screen reader names the poster on screen
  lbT.innerHTML = `${esc(L.title)}<span>${L.i + 1} / ${L.items.length}</span>`;
  lbD.innerHTML = L.items.length <= 40 ? L.items.map((_, k) => `<i class="${k === L.i ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('') : '';
}
function open(items, i, title){
  L = { items, i, title }; lastFocus = document.activeElement;
  lb.hidden = false; requestAnimationFrame(() => lb.classList.add('open')); show(i);
  document.getElementById('lbX').focus({ preventScroll: true });
}
function close(){ lb.classList.remove('open'); setTimeout(() => { lb.hidden = true; }, 360); lastFocus?.focus?.({ preventScroll: true }); }
host.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('.paper'); if (!b) return;
  const wEl = b.closest('.world'), w = WORLDS[+wEl.dataset.i], ii = +b.closest('.print').dataset.ii, it = w.items[ii];
  if (it.deck) open(it.deck, 0, it.title); else open(w.items, ii, w.label);
});
document.getElementById('lbX').addEventListener('click', close);
document.getElementById('lbP').addEventListener('click', () => show(L.i - 1));
document.getElementById('lbN').addEventListener('click', () => show(L.i + 1));
lb.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === lb || e.target.classList.contains('lb__stage')) close(); });
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (lb.hidden) return;
  if (e.key === 'Escape'){ e.stopImmediatePropagation(); close(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') show(L.i + 1);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') show(L.i - 1);
  if (e.key === 'Tab'){
    // Tab stays inside the open lightbox instead of walking onto the gallery behind it
    const f = [...lb.querySelectorAll('button,a[href],[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')].filter(n => n.offsetWidth || n.offsetHeight || n.getClientRects().length);
    if (!f.length) return;
    const first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
    if (!lb.contains(document.activeElement)){ e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
    else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first){ e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last){ e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }
}, true);
let sx = 0, sy = 0;
lb.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { sx = e.touches[0].clientX; sy = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
lb.addEventListener('touchend', e => { const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - sx, dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - sy; if (Math.abs(dx) > 45 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) show(L.i + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)); }, { passive: true });
</script>

<script>
// press F for full screen (again, or Esc, to leave); ignored while typing
(() => {
  const typing = e => { const t = e.target; return t && (t.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName)); };
  const toggle = () => {
    const d = document, el = d.documentElement;
    if (d.fullscreenElement || d.webkitFullscreenElement) (d.exitFullscreen || d.webkitExitFullscreen).call(d);
    else (el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen)?.call(el)?.catch?.(() => {});
  };
  addEventListener('keydown', e => {

    e.preventDefault();
    if (window.top !== window) { try { parent.postMessage({ wall: 'fullscreen' }, location.origin === 'null' ? '*' : location.origin); } catch (_) {} return; }
    toggle();
  });
  if (window.top === window) addEventListener('message', e => {
    // only one of this page's own frames can ask for full screen

})();

<script>
(() => {
  // every image and recording starts on a shimmering placeholder, which lifts as soon as it has something to show
  const done = el => el.parentElement && el.parentElement.classList.remove('skel');
  const watch = el => {
    const box = el.parentElement; if (!box || box.dataset.sk || el.closest('.app')) return; box.dataset.sk = 1;   // small app icons load instantly: no placeholder
    if (el.tagName === 'IMG'){
      if (el.complete && el.naturalWidth) return;
      box.classList.add('skel');
      el.addEventListener('load', () => done(el), { once: true }); el.addEventListener('error', () => done(el), { once: true });
    } else {
      // whenever it has to wait for more of the recording, the shimmer comes back over the poster
      el.addEventListener('waiting', () => box.classList.add('skel-buf'));
      ['playing', 'canplay', 'pause', 'error'].forEach(ev => el.addEventListener(ev, () => box.classList.remove('skel-buf')));
      if (el.readyState >= 2) return;
      box.classList.add('skel');
      el.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => done(el), { once: true });
      if (el.poster){ const im = new Image(); im.onload = () => done(el); im.src = el.poster; }
    }
  };
  const scan = () => document.querySelectorAll('main img, main video').forEach(watch);
  scan(); new MutationObserver(scan).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  const M = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const tick = () => { const d = new Date(), h = d.getHours();
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ftime]').forEach(e => e.textContent = `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}${h < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}`);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-fyear]').forEach(e => e.textContent = d.getFullYear()); };
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 20000);
  // size the footer name so it spans the full width with only a sliver of margin
  const fit = () => document.querySelectorAll('.sf').forEach(f => {
    const w = f.querySelector('.sf__word'); if (!w) return;
    const span = [...w.children].find(s => getComputedStyle(s).display !== 'none'); if (!span) return;
    w.style.setProperty('--wf', '100px');
    const k = (f.clientWidth * .955) / span.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    f.style.setProperty('--wf', (100 * k).toFixed(2) + 'px'); w.style.removeProperty('--wf');
  });
  fit(); addEventListener('resize', fit); document.fonts?.ready.then(fit);
  // the footer's rounded corners show whatever sits directly above it: find that section's colour and paint it behind them
  const sfw = document.querySelector('.sfw');
  const above = () => {
    if (!sfw) return;
    const solid = e => { const c = getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor; const m = c.match(/[\d.]+/g); return m && !(m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .05) ? c : ''; };
    let col = '', e = sfw.previousElementSibling;
    while (e){ if (e.getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth * .9){ const c = solid(e); if (c) col = c; } e = e.lastElementChild; }
    const bg = col || solid(document.body) || getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).backgroundColor;
    sfw.style.setProperty('--above', bg);
    // a dark section above: a hairline keeps the footer reading as its own section
    const m = (bg.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [255, 255, 255]).map(Number);
    sfw.classList.toggle('sfw--dark', (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255 < .25);
  };
  above(); addEventListener('load', above); addEventListener('resize', above);
  new MutationObserver(above).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode'] });
  // floating back-to-top: appears after the first screen, shows scroll progress, flips colour over dark backgrounds
  const tt = document.querySelector('.totop');
  if (tt) {
    const c = tt.querySelector('.ring circle'); tt.style.setProperty('--len', (2 * Math.PI * 24).toFixed(2));
    const lum = el => { for (let e = el; e && e !== document.documentElement; e = e.parentElement) {
        const m = getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g); if (!m) continue;
        if (m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .5) continue; return (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255; }
      const m = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [255,255,255];
      return (m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .5) ? (document.documentElement.dataset.mode === 'dark' ? 0 : 1) : (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255; };
    let raf = 0;
    const upd = () => { raf = 0;
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight, y = scrollY;
      const bot = document.querySelector('.sf__bot');  // the footer has its own 'Back to top', so step aside once it's on screen
      tt.classList.toggle('show', y > innerHeight * .9 && !(bot && bot.getBoundingClientRect().top < innerHeight - 8));
      tt.style.setProperty('--p', max > 0 ? Math.min(1, y / max).toFixed(4) : 0);
      const r = tt.getBoundingClientRect();
      tt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      const under = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2);
      tt.style.pointerEvents = '';
      if (under) tt.dataset.on = lum(under) < .45 ? 'dark' : 'light'; };
    const q = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(upd); };
    addEventListener('scroll', q, { passive: true }); addEventListener('resize', q);
    new MutationObserver(q).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode', 'class'] });
    upd();
  }
})();
</script>
